name: Earth Tremor

name: Spirit Protection

name: Erosion

name: Spirit Regeneration
desc: 11% chance per hit to cut summon cooldowns by 1 s, and an automatic 12% heal on a spirit below half health.

name: Mental Focus
desc: +11% mental-type accuracy and +0.3% Smite: the stat that makes your fears and seals actually land.

name: Chain Backflow
desc: Extra damage 50% of the time against targets already taking damage over time.

name: Spirit Communion

name: Contract of Revival
desc: +17% status resistance, stacking while you are controlled, plus an automatic 35% heal below 10% HP.

desc: Stigma. Joint attack with your spirit and the biggest groggy contribution in the kit: 50.

name: Gale
desc: Stigma. 10 s of +20% PvE / +10% PvP damage and tolerance for you and your spirits, plus 185-203 HP per second.

name: Blessing of Flame
desc: Stigma. For 10 s, every attack has a 50% chance of extra damage. Internal cooldown 1 s.

name: Summon: Ancient Spirit
desc: Stigma. A 30 s spirit whose every cast grants a 4-element charge, and it re-casts after 7 basic attacks.

name: Joint Strike: Corrosion
desc: Stigma. 20 s of Corrosion: +10% damage taken from spirits plus a DoT, and a different control per spirit.

name: Kaisinel's Authority
desc: Stigma. +20% status-ailment accuracy and +20% status resistance for 10 s: the window you land your fears in.

name: Absorption
desc: Stigma. Burns 300 of the target's MP and gives you 10% HP and 300 MP back: your resource steal.

name: Scream of Fear
desc: Stigma. AoE version of the fear: 50% chance on up to 4 enemies for 5 s (100% on NPCs).

name: Cursed Cloud
desc: Stigma. 4-target AoE that leaves a 10 s damage-over-time: it feeds the Chain Backflow passive.

name: Spell Steal
desc: Stigma. Strips up to 2 buffs from 4 enemies and hits harder for each one removed.

name: Spell Block
desc: Stigma. 75% chance to seal the target for 5 s: it locks the target's skills.

name: Fear
desc: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 30% fear that also gives you up to +20% defence, scaling with how many you hit.

name: Command: Proxy
desc: Stigma. For 5 s your spirit eats half the damage aimed at you, as long as it stays within 25 m.

name: Earth's Retribution
desc: Deals earth damage to a target within 20 m and restores 110 MP.

name: Judgment Lightning
desc: Deals wind damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away.

name: Mark of Weakening
desc: Deals wind damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away.

name: Holy Aura
desc: Summons a holy aura near you that lasts 5 s. The aura cannot move and periodically deals earth damage to a target you designate within 20 m.

name: Chain of Pain
desc: Deals earth damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away.

name: Lightning Barrage
desc: Deals damage to a target in a groggy state within 20 m.

name: Light of Regeneration
desc: Restores health to you and party members within 25 m every 2 s for 30 s.

name: Condemnation
desc: Deals earth damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away that is under the effect of Chain of Pain.

name: Light of Healing
desc: Restores health to the lowest-HP party member within 25 m and to yourself.

name: Radiance of Recovery
desc: Restores 315-347 health to you and party members within 25 m. At max charge the healing rises 50% and it removes 1 debuff.

name: Thunderclap
desc: Deals wind damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away.

name: Shock Release
desc: Clears your stun, knockdown, aerial bind, grab, freeze and fear states and grants Tenacity (강인함) for 5 s.

name: Lightning
desc: Deals wind damage to a target within 20 m and restores 110 MP.

name: Discharge
desc: Deals wind damage to a target within 20 m and restores 150 MP.

name: Divine Punishment
desc: Deals wind damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away.

name: Blessing of Regeneration
desc: Restores your health and 40% of your mana.

name: Warm Blessing
desc: Your max HP rises 6% and your max MP 7%.

name: Sovereign's Blessing
desc: Your block rises by 200 and you recover health on a successful block. Internal cooldown: 5 s.

name: Sovereign's Grace
desc: Your critical rises by 100 and your Smite by 0.2%, and every time you land an attack you deal extra damage to the target.

name: Healing Power Boost
desc: Your healing amplification rises 10% and rises further in proportion to your attack power.

name: Veil of Immortality
desc: Your defense rises 2% and your critical resistance by 901.

name: Recovery Block
desc: Every time an attack lands, 7% chance to cut the target's received healing by 32% for 5 s.

name: Prayer of Focus
desc: When your health is at 50% or less, it creates a damage-absorbing shield for 30 s and raises your healing amplification by 20%.

name: Grace of the Earth
desc: Your critical damage amplification rises 3% and your accuracy by 100.

name: Will to Survive
desc: Your status-ailment resistance rises 17%, and being hit by a control effect gives you +12% PvE and +6% PvP damage tolerance for 5 s.

name: Radiant Blessing
desc: Every time an attack lands, 7% chance to heal you and party members within 40 m.

name: Burst of Authority
desc: Deals earth damage to a target within 20 m. Groggy gauge damage: 50.

name: Absolution
desc: Removes up to 2 debuffs from you and party members within 25 m and restores their health.

name: Authority of Life
desc: Summons a healing aura near you that lasts 15 s. The aura cannot move and periodically heals the caster and party members within 7 m.

name: Prayer of Amplification
desc: For 10 s your attack power rises 20%.

name: Summon Revive
desc: Revives dead party members within 40 m, next to you.

name: Earth's Punishment
desc: Deals earth damage to a target within 20 m and damages it every 1 s for 10 s.

name: Salvation
desc: For 3 s you take no damage and no status ailments. Some powerful attacks cannot be defended against.

name: Bind
desc: Deals earth damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away and with a 75% chance roots them for 10 s.

name: Light of Protection
desc: Raises PvE damage amplification and PvE damage tolerance by 10.5%, and the PvP pair by 5.25%, for you and nearby party members.

name: Authority of Yustiel
desc: For 10 s, your PvE damage tolerance and that of party members within 40 m rises 20% and the PvP tolerance 10%.

name: Voice of Ruin
desc: Deals earth damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away.

name: Assault Mark
desc: Deals damage to up to 4 enemies within 4 m of a target 20 m away and with a 30% chance roots them.

name: Noble Energy
desc: Summons a noble aura near you that lasts 5 minutes. The aura accompanies the caster and attacks the target alongside them, dealing damage within 20 m.

name: Incredible Blow
desc: Your left click: 4-target melee hit that gives back 100 MP. Opens the Resonance / Thunderbolt chain.

name: Incandescent Blow
desc: Your right click: 4-target melee filler with no resource return. 2 groggy gauge.

name: Charge Strike
desc: Your gap closer: charges a target up to 20 m away, hits up to 4 enemies and gives back 100 MP.

name: Impact Strike
desc: Your main stun: 60% chance of 3 s (100% on NPCs). It is what sets up Wave Blow and Dark Crush.

name: Dark Crush
desc: Only fires against a stunned, knocked-down or air-bound target. Against control-immune targets it still procs 7% of the time.

name: Windrage Fury
desc: Only fires against a groggy target in melee: free damage during the groggy window.

name: Scorch Strike
desc: Only fires on a successful block: 4-target AoE with a 40% seal for 3 s. Your reward for holding the shield up.

name: Recuperation
desc: Your group heal: heals you and the party within 25 m, cleanses 1 debuff, then heals again every 2 s for 8 s.

name: Vibration Strike
desc: Only available after an emergency evade: closes to a target within 10 m with a 50% stun. Your counter-attack.

name: Wave Blow
desc: Only fires against a stunned target and knocks it down for 3 s: the second link of your control chain.

name: Spin Strike
desc: 4-target AoE that stacks +5% critical damage and +5% healing amplification for 30 s, up to 3 times.

name: Shock Release
desc: Your only real cleanse: clears stun, knockdown, air-bind, grab, freeze and fear, then 5 s of status immunity.

name: Resonance Strike
desc: Second hit of the left-click chain, option 1 of 2. Same 100 MP return as Incredible Blow.

name: Thunderbolt Strike
desc: The other second hit of the left-click chain, and the bigger mana return: 120 MP.

name: Rupture Strike
desc: Incandescent Blow's chain follow-up: the same 4-target melee hit, worth another 2 groggy gauge.

name: Forceful Strike
desc: Shock Release's chain: a guaranteed 3 s stun on up to 4 enemies around you, right after you break a control.

name: Blessing of Life
desc: +6.5% max HP and +5% healing amplification: the passive that decides how much your heals are worth.

name: Cross Guard
desc: +200 block and HP back on every successful block: it is what makes Scorch Strike fire.

name: Protective Ward
desc: Every hit stacks a ward; 10 stacks give you and the party a 10 s shield. Below 50% HP you also get a personal one.

name: Spell of Inspiration
desc: +100 critical and +0.5% Perfect. The Perfect curve at rank 20 is what makes it worth maxing.

name: Attack Readiness
desc: +5.5% PvE, +2.75% PvP, +2% defence and +100 accuracy: the all-round passive, and the defence curve is huge.

name: Impact Hit
desc: +11.2% impact-type accuracy and +0.3% Smite: the stat that makes your stuns and knockdowns actually land.

name: Spell of Fury
desc: Bonus damage against targets in an impact-type state or groggy: it pays off your own stun chain.

name: Earth's Promise
desc: Your attacks cut the target's PvE tolerance by 10.5% and PvP by 5.25% for 5 s. It does not stack with a Cleric's Chain of Pain.

name: Will to Survive
desc: +17% status resistance, and being controlled gives you +12% PvE / +6% PvP tolerance plus stacking resistance.

name: Wind's Promise
desc: On a critical, 50% chance of bonus damage to the target.

name: Extinguishing Flame
desc: Stigma. 4-target melee AoE with a 50% knockdown and the biggest groggy contribution in the kit: 50.

name: Undefeated Mantra
desc: Stigma. Party-wide +10.5% PvE damage and tolerance, +5.25% PvP. Does not stack with a Cleric's Light of Protection.

name: Focused Defense
desc: Stigma. A guaranteed weapon block with +100% block damage reduction, returning 110 mana and 110 stamina.

name: Sprint Mantra
desc: Stigma. Party-wide +10.5% movement speed, plus a 15% chance to heal on every landed attack.

name: Crushing Strike
desc: Stigma. Fast charge at a target up to 20 m away, hitting 20% harder if the target is in an impact-type state.

name: Marcutan's Wrath
desc: Stigma. 4-target AoE that arms Dark Crush on the target for 7 s with no control needed.

name: Blocking Power
desc: Stigma. A 20 s shield blocking 3944 damage on you and every party member within 40 m.

name: Binding Brand
desc: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 50% seal for 5 s (100% on NPCs): it locks their skills.

name: Hand of Grace
desc: Stigma. Instant group heal of 1171 to 1289 HP on you and the party within 25 m.

name: Power of the Storm
desc: Stigma. 10 s of +20% combat speed and -20% skill cooldowns for you and the party within 40 m.

name: Blessing of Guardian
desc: Stigma. 5 minutes of +1840 max HP, and it heals you the same 1840 instantly.

name: Assault Shock
desc: Stigma. 4-target AoE with a 30% stun that also gives you up to +20% defence, scaling with how many you hit.

name: Barrier Spell
desc: Stigma. For 3 s nobody in the party within 40 m can drop below 10% HP: the raid save.
